exact_discriminators: Control/Vite7 reached clean lock + npm ci but failed before Electron launch because the exact Electron binary had not yet been materialized; Electron 44 downloads its binary on first dev run or through its package-provided install-electron helper.
Vite8 lock contains no node_modules/esbuild entry; the approval helper incorrectly treated absence of esbuild as fatal even though Vite8's resolved graph does not require that package.
These are harness/install-mechanics discriminators; they do not prove Vite 5/7/8 incompatibility.
